title: Prioritize top accounts by deal velocity + risk signals for roadmap translation
creator: Rina Shah
description: Design and ship a deterministic intake + prioritization pipeline that translates signals from Sales/CS/Support into roadmap commitments or staggered ask lanes for top accounts. The pipeline should surface high-velocity deals and high-risk escalations, score them consistently, and produce clear routing and SLA expectations for engineering/product capacity planning.
problem_statement: We currently accept disparate top-account asks via email, ticket, and Slack. This leads to ad-hoc promises, unclear priority relative to net-new deals, and last-minute scope changes that cause churn or missed SLAs. We need a repeatable, auditable process that balances revenue velocity with long-term technical cost and platform health.
goals: Create a single intake form and event stream for top-account asks to replace ad-hoc channels
Define a transparent scoring model combining deal velocity, renewal date, technical impact, and escalation severity
Automate routing to PR/roadmap lanes (Immediate Commit / Trimmed Commit / Watchlist)
Pilot with Sales (AE/SE), CS, and Enterprise Support for 30 top accounts in Q2
success_metrics: Time from intake to routing decision <= 3 business days
>= 90% of top-account asks created via the intake form after pilot start
Reduction in ad-hoc scope-change incidents for pilot accounts by 50%
Correlation: prioritized items yield >$X incremental ARR or materially reduce churn risk in 6 months
proposal_summary: Build a lightweight Top-Account Signal Router (TASR): 1) intake form + Slack/GH trigger, 2) scoring engine that weights Deal Velocity (30%), Renewal Proximity (20%), Escalation Severity (25%), Product-risk technical delta (15%), and Strategic importance (10%), 3) automated routing to Roadmap lanes with SLAs and required artifacts (PRD link, risk assessment, SLO impact), and 4) dashboard for PM/TPM sign-off and roll-call.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form live in Prod and embedded in CS playbook
Scoring engine implemented as a simple, auditable rule set stored in config repo
Slack notifications and routing created for Immediate Commit / Trimmed Commit / Watchlist
Dashboard widget in Console showing queue, scores, and decision timestamps
Pilot executed for 30 accounts and we have at least 12 completed intake evaluations with outcomes logged
decisions: Use a deterministic weighted scoring model (no ML in initial pilot) to keep decisions auditable
Pilot lanes: Immediate Commit (deliver within release), Trimmed Commit (MVP + roadmap backlog), Watchlist (monitor metrics & negotiate timing)
Product/Eng sign-off required for Immediate Commit; Program-level review for Trimmed Commit
Integrate intake with Salesforce Opportunity ID and Gainsight customer ID for data enrichment
